propositions: The checker must unify split link validation logic from script and unit-test parser into one deterministic repository-relative link validator
Relative Markdown links and images must resolve from source directories to any target inside the repository; targets escaping the repository must be rejected with deterministic findings
The checker must retain top-level docs index membership as a separate rule and scan only inline links outside fenced blocks and inline code spans

Sources must include root Markdown, docs/, .agents/, .github/, examples/agent-skills/, infra runbooks, scripts README, src/rebar/_guides, src/rebar/llm/eval_specs, templates, and tests/external README; excluded sources like .joe-janitor and src/rebar/llm/reviewers may remain valid link targets
Query strings and fragments must be stripped before file resolution; scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, and reference-style links must be ignored
docs/documentation-policy.md must document the source boundary, parser behavior, and exclusions with findings sorted by source path and line number
